records.title: Shreibman family of Sokółka
records.summary: The Sokółka Yizkor Book lists Meir Shreibman, his wife Dabeh, and their sons Gabriel and Reuben in the memorial necrology. The same index also lists Itzkeh and Dorah Shreibman, but does not establish that they belonged to this immediate household.
